scope: frozen 347-page scientific component quality; does not qualify complete PDFs, scientific scans or cross-page tables

text.normalization: Unicode NFC; collapse all Unicode whitespace runs to one ASCII space and strip ends; preserve case, punctuation, Markdown and inline LaTeX literally
text.goldIgnore: exclude only ignore=true and categories outside mapping; retain every included nonempty text block

matching.algorithm: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment on explicit (G+P)x(G+P) deletion/insertion augmented cost matrix per page and family
matching.pairCost: raw character Levenshtein distance of normalized contents; no division by candidate length
matching.emptyInputs: all gold deletions or all prediction insertions
matching.tieBreak: fixed gold annotation order and original prediction block order; scipy1.10.1 deterministic result, no alternate matching search

text.cer: sum character edits including unmatched prediction insertions / sum normalized gold characters; may exceed 1
text.wer: same character-based assignment; sum whitespace-token Levenshtein edits including unmatched predictions / sum gold whitespace-token counts; Chinese whitespace WER is not segmented-language WER
text.aggregate: micro totals plus macro over pages with nonempty gold; always emit all 347 page rows; zero-gold denominators remain null and insertion counts remain explicit
text.invalidOrMissingPrediction: empty predicted page, retain page and all gold deletion errors; malformed/truncated raw bytes preserved

readingOrderDiagnostic.gold: body/title/reference blocks with explicit numeric order only; never invent order0
readingOrderDiagnostic.prediction: original output order of matching families; unmatched retained
readingOrderDiagnostic.unorderedGold: count per page/family; no-order headers/footers do not enter this diagnostic

official.markdownProjection: join every valid structured block content in output order with two newlines; wrap display_formula content in $$ delimiters only if absent, inline_formula in $ only if absent; no content repair; invalid page is empty
official.denominatorAudit: derive expected applicable gold rows using unchanged official matcher with empty prediction pages before arm scores; compare page plus gt row identity with each arm; missing/shifted gold coverage invalidates quality acceptance; no silent exclusion
official.goldRendering: every applicable CDM gold must produce nonzero glyph boxes; missing rendering is invalid evaluation, never a model score
official.extraPredictions: report all unmatched structured blocks by category using independent maximum IoU assignment at IoU>=0.5 within explicit category family; this is geometric-unmatched evidence, not proof of hallucination
official.readingOrderLimitation: known perfect table fixture loses table position upstream; no acceptance based on that metric

extraBlockGeometry.normalization: gold poly bounding rectangle / page dimensions; predicted bbox /1000; no clipping
extraBlockGeometry.matching: one-to-one maximum IoU assignment per family; only IoU>=0.5 pairs count
